A brotherhood forged through years of creation

ERIC CHAPMAN

The brother. The strategist. The designer. The man who stood beside the vision.

More than a name on a credit line. Eric Chapman has been part of Brian Chapman Sr.'s creative journey from the beginning — building ideas, shaping games, and standing beside his brother through the work.

DISCOVER OUR STORYENTER OUR CREATIVE WORLDS
✦ TWO BROTHERS   ✦   ONE CREATIVE JOURNEY   ✦   STRATEGY · STORY · DESIGN · LEGACY   ✦
Not a side character. A central figure.

THIS IS ERIC'S STAGE.

When Brian speaks about the work, he speaks about his brother. Eric isn't simply someone who arrived after the ideas took shape. According to Brian, Eric has designed alongside him from the very start.

His identity reaches beyond a single project: war-games producer, LEGION game designer, leader of his own Wiccan church, and a person Brian describes as having been at the top of his class. The combination of creative discipline, leadership, and shared history is what this showcase honours.

Here, Eric gets the space usually reserved for the biggest names: a dramatic entrance, a story worth reading, and an entire collection of creative worlds to explore.

THE CHAPMAN
CRESCENT
Brian Chapman Sr. × Eric Chapman

BUILT BY BROTHERS.
NOT BUILT ALONE.

This is the partnership at the heart of the story. Brian brings a universe of books, games, songs, programs, and experimental ideas. Eric has been beside him in the creative process, helping design from the beginning. The work is varied; the bond runs through it.

I

The Beginning

Before the galleries and the websites, there were two brothers sharing ideas and working together. The starting point is the partnership, not a product launch.

II

The Building

War games, imagined systems, storytelling, and digital worlds grow through collaboration. Eric's design presence is part of the journey Brian wants people to see.

III

The Legacy

Now the creations can be experienced publicly. This website opens a door to that work while giving Eric recognition as an important collaborator.

THE CRESCENT
& THE SHIELD
A symbol of brotherhood

THE CHAPMAN CRESCENT.

A custom heraldic emblem for a modern creative partnership.

The crescent stands for imagination and renewal. The crossed swords represent strategy and the challenges faced together. The shield speaks to loyalty; the lions to courage. The stone hall gives Eric's stage a British and European medieval atmosphere.

This is original, symbolic artwork created for the site — not a historically verified Chapman coat of arms.
